headline: Weathered Expanse Shifts Anew as Heavy Fighting Grips Four Sectors
war_summary: The line has moved again since the previous edition. Weathered Expanse, four Warden posts to five Colonial at the last filing, now stands two Warden to seven Colonial with none unclaimed, and its thirty-nine events in the past day lead the map; Crow's Nest and Wightwalk remain the busiest names, and five filings arrived in the last two hours. Nevish Line has narrowed to five Warden and three Colonial, with Blackcoat Way and Blinding Stones still contested. Callahan's Passage, quiet earlier, has stirred again on three filings around Crumbling Post and Scáth Passing, though its ten posts still divide eight to two Warden. Kuura Strand's last unclaimed post has gone Colonial, leaving five Warden and one Colonial around Talven and Menneen. In Mooring County the Wind Hills passed to Colonial hands, trimming eleven Warden posts to one Colonial. Stlican Shelf's ruined post has been rebuilt under Warden colours, restoring a three-to-six split. Palantine Berm filed four events in the two hours to the cutoff. Casualty ledgers run heaviest in Weathered Expanse, Callahan's Passage, Nevish Line, Stlican Shelf and Mooring County. Viper Pit reports brisk losses without a single post changing hands. No victor has been declared.
